title: Query samples and database owner
description: For query_stats lasting at least 500 ms return exactly four columns: sample_id, database_name, owner_role, duration_ms. Join query_stats to databases, then owner_role_id to db_roles. Sort by duration_ms DESC, then sample_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT q.id AS sample_id, d.name AS database_name, r.role_name AS owner_role, q.duration_ms
FROM query_stats AS q
hints: database_id links a sample to a database; owner_role_id links the database to its role.
The duration_ms threshold applies to query_stats.
solution_explanation: Two chained joins add database and owner context to each measurement.
